jobs.title: Business Analyst
jobs.description:
Dynamic Solution Innovators (DSi), a Dhaka-based software company, is hiring a Business Analyst with 1–3 years of experience. The role covers requirements analysis, process mapping, documentation, and client collaboration across pre-sales and project delivery, from opportunity assessment to final handover.

## Responsibilities

- Gather client needs, pain points, and expected outcomes through meetings, workshops, and site visits as needed.
- Document As-Is and To-Be processes, feature lists, epics, user stories, inception reports, and UI/UX flows.
- Work with the Documentation Team to develop Software Requirements Specifications (SRS) and Software Design Documents (SDD).
- Validate processes, workflows, and UI/UX designs with clients throughout the analysis phase.
- Collaborate with Sales and Tech Leads on project scoping, requirements discovery, and initial solution planning.
- Prepare scoping documents, milestone structures, and risk assessments, and develop effort estimates with Tech Lead support.
- Contribute technical content and process and architecture diagrams to RFP/EOI responses.
- Keep Project Managers, developers, QA, and UI/UX teams aligned on requirements throughout delivery. Provide ongoing clarifications and maintain accurate, consistent requirements as systems evolve.
- Lead client requirement walkthroughs, validation and feedback sessions, and presentations of workflows, prototypes, and To-Be processes to align stakeholders.
- Support Project Managers during user acceptance testing (UAT), piloting, and deployment.

## Requirements

- Have 1–3 years of experience.
- Communicate effectively in English and Bengali, explaining complex ideas clearly and concisely.
- Demonstrate strong analytical thinking, problem-solving skills, and attention to detail.
- Organize information logically and produce clear, structured documentation.
- Have hands-on experience with business analysis documentation, including SRS, Business Requirements Documents (BRD), and As-Is and To-Be process documents.
- Show an interest in software systems and enthusiasm for organizing and documenting technical processes.
- Be proficient in Microsoft Word, Excel, Google Sheets, and other productivity or collaboration tools.
- Have strong computer literacy and be willing to learn new technologies and tools quickly.
- Manage time effectively and handle multiple deliverables in parallel.

Preferred qualifications:

- Experience with Government of Bangladesh (GoB) projects is a plus.
- A bachelor’s degree in BBA, CS, CSE, EEE, ETE, or a related field is preferred.

## Work arrangements

- There are 2 weekly holidays: Friday and Saturday.
- Site visits may be required for requirements gathering.

## Salary and benefits

- Receive free lunch and snacks on campus.
- Receive 2 festival bonuses, healthcare coverage, and a yearly salary increment.
- Work alongside experienced professionals on international and government-level projects.
- Join a supportive environment that encourages learning.

## How to apply

The application deadline is 30 Oct 2026.

Monitor regulatory changes and maintain compliance registers, permits, licenses and statutory reporting.
- Lead organization-wide risk assessments and mitigation programs. Develop safety systems, standards, procedures and safe work practices covering hazard identification, incident prevention and behavior-based safety.
- Investigate serious incidents, near misses and occupational injuries to identify root causes and preventive actions. Monitor safety through audits, inspections, observations and leading indicators, and strengthen contractor safety and employee participation.
- Oversee environmental programs covering waste, emissions, resource efficiency, pollution prevention, permits and reporting. Track performance and support energy efficiency, water conservation, waste reduction and climate-related objectives.
- Provide EHS oversight across manufacturing facilities and support functions. Conduct site reviews and management inspections, integrate EHS into production, maintenance, engineering and quality processes, and implement process and machine safety programs.
- Set safety standards for warehouses, fleets, transportation and distribution. Ensure safe handling, storage and transport of raw materials, chemicals and finished products, implement road safety and defensive driving programs, and monitor contractors and third-party logistics providers.
- Maintain emergency response plans for facilities and offices. Coordinate fire safety programs, drills, evacuation exercises and crisis response; liaise with government authorities, fire services, hospitals and emergency agencies; and support business continuity planning.
- Implement and improve EHS management systems. Manage ISO 14001, ISO 45001 and other applicable certification and surveillance audits, and ensure timely closure of findings and corrective actions.
- Develop annual training and competency programs, including appropriate orientation for employees, contractors and visitors. Lead awareness campaigns and safety communications, engage leadership, and coach operational leaders on EHS ownership and accountability.
- Establish KPIs and dashboards, analyze incident trends, audit findings, risk data and compliance indicators, and report to the CPOO, Executive Management Team and Board as required. Use findings to drive improvements.
- Lead and develop factory-based EHS Officers and other EHS personnel through supervision, performance management, coaching, succession planning and capability development. Coordinate with Operations, Engineering, HR, Supply Chain, Quality and Administration.
- Use AI predictive analytics and machine learning to assess incidents, near misses and behavioral data and forecast potential accidents. Implement IoT wearables and smart sensors to monitor gas leaks, heat stress, unsafe noise and fatigue in real time.
- Deploy AI-assisted computer vision through existing CCTV networks to monitor PPE compliance and restrict access to high-risk zones. Introduce automated compliance tracking, real-time ESG and safety dashboards, and AI-augmented facility inspections that process datasets and images.
- Ensure AI safety tools protect employee privacy and meet ethical, compliance and governance standards. Keep safety professionals responsible for complex investigations and critical interventions, supported by AI through human-in-the-loop governance.
- Integrate emerging digital tools into ISO 45001 and ISO 14001 management systems, and develop training frameworks using VR and personalized AI-driven safety modules.
- Carry out other tasks assigned by management.

jobs.description:

- Record pilot designs, progress and lessons in formats suitable for the Pilot Tracker and Failure Report.
- Review BRAC’s programme portfolio and external partner ecosystem to identify shared solutions and prevent duplicated effort.
- Provide subject expertise for the Frugal Innovation Forum, BRAC X, BRAC Innovation Exhibition, Innovation Adda and Failure Talk when requested by the Senior Manager.
- Protect programme participants, people who interact with BRAC and team members from harm, abuse, neglect, harassment and exploitation, including sexual exploitation and abuse (SEA). Provide safeguarding guidance and support to maintain a safe working environment.
- Promote BRAC’s safeguarding policy, apply safeguarding standards throughout the work, follow incident reporting procedures and encourage others to report incidents.

## Requirements

- A bachelor’s degree in Development Studies, Social Sciences, Economics, Education, Public Policy or a related field is required.
- At least 3 years of relevant development-sector experience in youth employment, skills development, livelihoods or innovation/design work is required.
- Formal training or certification in human-centred design, design thinking or facilitation, such as from IDEO.org or LUMA Institute, is an added advantage.
- Strong facilitation skills are required to lead design sprints and workshops with diverse programme stakeholders.
- Strong relationship-building skills, dependability and the ability to establish trust quickly with programme teams and partners are required.
- Sound project management skills are required to handle multiple pilot engagements concurrently.
- Analytical skills are required to translate field observations into testable pilot designs.

## Salary and benefits

- Benefits include a festival bonus, contributory provident fund, gratuity, health and life insurance, maternity/paternity leave, wellness centre and day care facilities, and other benefits under BRAC policy.

- Strong communication, facilitation, training and stakeholder engagement skills are required, along with the ability to deliver capacity-building sessions, coaching and technical support to frontline staff and community-based personnel.

## Salary and benefits

jobs.title: Senior Marketing Operations Manager
jobs.description:
Field Nation is hiring a Senior Marketing Operations Manager to lead the technology, data and analytics behind its ABM and AI demand engine. The role requires proactive ownership and close collaboration with Marketing and Revenue Operations (RevOps) to improve systems, revenue processes and business performance.

## Responsibilities

- Own and design the marketing technology ecosystem, including HubSpot, 6sense, ChiliPiper and AI platforms. Lead the roadmap and proactively recommend investments to address weaknesses and capability gaps.
- Jointly own marketing technology integration with Salesforce alongside RevOps leadership, protecting data integrity and improving efficiency and productivity.
- Build and maintain dashboards, reports and analytics infrastructure, anticipating leadership’s information needs.
- Identify data anomalies, performance declines, system risks, conversion drops and attribution failures early, and recommend solutions.
- Independently analyze campaign performance, ABX play ROI, inbound quality against baseline and conversion patterns by segment to guide major decisions.
- Manage the marketing database, audience segmentation, list governance, data hygiene and enrichment strategy.
- Partner with RevOps on marketing-to-sales handoffs, lead management and shared funnel metrics. Maintain compliance with GDPR, CAN-SPAM and other applicable regulations through opt-in strategies and data privacy controls.
- Advise the Senior Director, Revenue Marketing on the platform roadmap, budget, capability investments, and team and program performance.
- Collaborate with marketing managers on program design that depends on platforms and shared systems. Meet regularly with RevOps leadership to align priorities, govern Salesforce and improve cross-functional revenue processes.
- Coach marketing individual contributors on platform practices, tool capabilities and process discipline. Establish scalable governance, documentation, training and adherence to platform standards.

## Requirements

- Have 8+ years of marketing operations experience, including 3+ years as a senior individual contributor or manager at a B2B SaaS or services company, with demonstrated breadth and depth.
- Have deep, hands-on experience operating an ABX or intent platform at production scale, such as 6sense, Demandbase, Terminus or an equivalent. This must include platform configuration, intent activation, account scoring development and tuning, and play orchestration; surface-level familiarity is insufficient.
- Have administration and architecture experience with HubSpot or an equivalent marketing automation platform (MAP), including building and rebuilding the stack at scale.
- Be fluent in Salesforce navigation, reporting and integration troubleshooting, and able to collaborate effectively with RevOps.
- Have production experience with AI or agent tools, such as AgentForce, 6sense AI email agents, conversational AI or comparable marketing tools. Leading an AI rollout from evaluation through production is a bonus.
- Be able to independently prepare clean datasets, conduct rigorous analysis and present defensible conclusions. SQL proficiency or strong reporting-tool fluency is required.
- Demonstrate proactive problem-solving through examples of identifying issues before they escalate, using data to drive cross-functional decisions or delivering successful platform investments.
- Communicate clearly through architecture documentation, executive summaries and training.
- Have experience leading platform consolidation, MAP migration or substantial technology-stack rationalization.
- Have coaching or formal management experience.
- Have experience in a two-sided marketplace, services marketplace or field-service business.
- Have experience implementing AI or automation in marketing operations.
- Hold a bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Information Systems, Analytics or a related field.

## Work arrangements

- Work Monday to Friday in a hybrid arrangement, with 3 work-from-home days and 2 mandatory office days each week.
- Working hours are 1:00 PM to 10:00 PM.
- The office is in Uttara, Dhaka, Bangladesh.

## Salary and benefits

- Monthly salary is BDT 170,000–230,000.
- Financial benefits include the Field Nation LLC Performance Reward, festival bonus, successful employee referral bonuses, gratuity and year-end encashment of unused annual leave.
- Health benefits include medical insurance for employees, their spouses and children, plus gym membership.
- Office and connectivity benefits include complimentary lunch/dinner, unlimited tea and coffee, transportation and a mobile data allowance.
- A career development budget supports professional learning and growth.
- Team benefits include 2 annual retreats during Summer and Winter Field Weeks, a quarterly team outing budget, and occasional gifts for milestones and new joiners.
- Leave benefits include paid annual, casual and sick leave, plus Hajj/Umrah, maternity and paternity leave.

jobs.title: Software Engineer (Fullstack)

- Communicate across teams, including management, nontechnical colleagues, and external parties.

## Requirements

### Mandatory qualifications

- Have a bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related field with 3+ years of industry experience, or an equivalent combination of education, training, and experience.
- Be proficient in writing production code manually and with AI coding agents such as Claude Code, Cursor, or Codex. Review, refactor, and take ownership of AI-generated code, and critically assess suggestions for correctness, security, and performance.
- Have excellent development experience with PHP (7+), JavaScript, and NodeJS.
- Have 3+ years of experience building modern, responsive, cross-browser-compatible websites using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, along with experience in cross-browser compatibility testing.
- Have experience with Tailwind CSS, Material Design and/or Bootstrap 5, and familiarity with CSS preprocessors such as Sass, Less, or Stylus.
- Know JavaScript frameworks such as React, Angular, or Vue.
- Have experience with Symfony, Laravel, and/or CodeIgniter, as well as Webpack, Grunt, and Gulp.
- Understand AI principles, algorithms, and techniques, and be familiar with LLM architectures, including Transformer-based models, the Llama family, and GPT variants.
- Be skilled in prompting and context engineering to obtain reliable results from LLM-based tools.
- Have strong API experience and be comfortable integrating LLM APIs, including function/tool calling, structured outputs, streaming, and token and cost management.
- Have strong experience with data modeling, relational databases, SQL, database administration, and complex queries, plus extensive experience with NoSQL databases such as MongoDB and DynamoDB.
- Have demonstrated experience supporting enterprise-level, mission-critical applications.
- Understand secure coding fundamentals, including the OWASP Top 10, input validation, authentication and authorization, and secrets management.
- Understand how virtualization and containerization support scalability, reliability, and faster delivery.
- Have exceptional written and oral communication skills, including good English communication and the ability to turn complex information into concise executive summaries for internal and external audiences.
- Demonstrate mature judgment, sound decision-making, strong analytical and problem-solving skills, honesty, dedication, and responsibility.

### Preferred qualifications

- Experience with Next.js and Redis/Memcached.
- Experience with PHPUnit, Mocha, Jest, or similar testing tools.
- Experience with server technologies, particularly AWS, Docker applications, and Kubernetes.
- Familiarity with open-source software and tools such as JIRA, Jenkins, Elasticsearch, Grafana, and Kibana.
- Understanding of vector databases and embedding models.

- Experience with prompt evaluation and testing practices for AI features.

jobs.title: Legal Executive

- Follow the Board’s direction to establish program priorities, develop operating policies and guidelines, and communicate policies and priorities. Improve internal practices, work processes and procedures, and identify training needs.
- Organize internal legal meetings and coordinate with Business, Accounts & Finance, HR and other departments. Maintain effective relationships with internal and external contacts.

## Requirements

## Responsibilities

- Develop and implement a Risk-Based Internal Audit (RBIA) framework and Annual Audit Plan covering branches, sub-branches, Head Office divisions and departments, business units, subsidiaries, digital channels, and all other auditable areas.

- Ensure comprehensive audit coverage of credit, general banking, cash, foreign exchange, trade finance, treasury, cards, digital banking, procurement, finance, HR, and other critical operations.
- Oversee credit audits covering appraisal, approval, documentation, disbursement, monitoring, classification, provisioning, recovery, rescheduling/restructuring, collateral management, and compliance with delegated authority and regulatory requirements.
- Assess the reliability and integrity of financial and operational information and check whether transactions and activities follow approved policies, procedures, regulations, and delegated authorities.
- Conduct or supervise assigned investigations into suspected fraud, forgery, misappropriation, financial irregularities, unauthorized transactions, policy violations, control failures, and other misconduct.
- Coordinate with specialist resources to audit Core Banking Systems, information systems, cyber security controls, user access, digital banking, cards, alternative delivery channels, data integrity, and technology-related processes.
- Review compliance with Bangladesh Bank directives, the Bank Company Act, BFIU requirements, other applicable laws and regulations, and internal policies and procedures.
- Produce clear audit reports identifying material findings, control deficiencies, root causes, risk implications, responsible functions, and practical corrective recommendations.
- Establish tracking and follow-up processes for audit observations and ensure timely closure, particularly for high-risk, recurring, and long-outstanding findings.
- Use trend and root-cause analysis to identify systemic weaknesses and recommend improvements to processes, systems, controls, policies, and accountability.
- Undertake special audits, surprise inspections, thematic reviews, process audits, and investigations in response to emerging risks, regulatory concerns, Management/Board instructions, or control weaknesses.
- Present significant findings, major weaknesses, irregularities, unresolved observations, and corrective-action progress to the Board Audit Committee and other relevant authorities.
- Coordinate, where applicable, with Bangladesh Bank inspectors, external/statutory auditors, and other regulatory or assurance bodies, and monitor implementation of audit-related observations.

- Promote preventive auditing by identifying emerging control risks and recommending action before significant financial, operational, regulatory, or reputational harm occurs.
- Maintain independence, objectivity, integrity, confidentiality, and professional skepticism, and protect audit activities from undue influence.
- Lead and develop the Audit team through manpower planning, deployment, professional development, specialized training, performance management, and succession planning.

- Applicants must understand Bangladesh Bank’s Internal Control & Compliance guidelines, Risk-Based Internal Audit, the Bank Company Act, BFIU requirements, corporate governance requirements, and other applicable banking laws and regulations.
- Proven experience is required in branch and Head Office audits, credit audits, operational and financial audits, special audits/investigations, regulatory inspection compliance, audit follow-up, and internal control assessment.

jobs.description:
CARE Bangladesh is hiring 1 Deputy Head of Office for its Humanitarian Response Program at the Cox’s Bazar Regional Office. Reporting to the Director–Humanitarian & Resilient Future program and serving on the regional Senior Management Team, the role leads the Rohingya Refugee Response, oversees office operations and support functions, and ensures programme quality, accountability, and gender inclusion.

## Responsibilities

- **Programme management and implementation — 35%:** Align sectors, grants, and projects with country and response strategies, and coordinate integrated delivery that responds promptly and effectively to refugee needs. Oversee daily implementation, documentation, outcomes, impact, and sustainability.
- Lead resource mobilisation with the Dhaka Resource Mobilisation and Programme teams. Oversee budgeting and expenditure tracking, identify funding opportunities and challenges, ensure cost proposals meet CARE and donor requirements, and negotiate with donors where needed.
- Allocate staff, funding, and materials according to programme needs and CARE and donor regulations. Ensure compliance with financial, administrative, HR, procurement, and Go/No-Go policies.
- Manage partnerships with local and international organisations, supporting capacity building, shared learning, and communication. Prioritise gender mainstreaming, inclusion, and development of a standalone gender programme.
- Lead contingency planning and preparedness for hazards affecting refugees and host communities. Keep the Director and DCD-P informed of security threats, and work with the Security Manager to apply CARE Security Guidelines locally.
- **General management and leadership — 30%:** Line-manage programme/project managers and sector leads, and provide matrix management of Finance, HR, and Programme Support in coordination with relevant Dhaka department heads. Strengthen coordination between regional and Dhaka support teams, including administration, fundraising, logistics, and procurement.
- Maintain relationships with NGOs, UN agencies, donors, government, and other stakeholders. Recommend improvements to emergency team structures and partner arrangements, and maintain programme records, models, and lessons learned.
- Conduct performance appraisals, provide regular feedback and mentoring, and ensure staff understand their financial and administrative duties. Promote teamwork, staff morale, well-being, learning, and high performance.
- Keep the Country Director and senior Dhaka staff informed through the Director about response strategies, plans, progress, and significant developments. Establish reliable reporting to CARE, donors, and government, and systems for understanding and tracking statutory and internal compliance.
- Promote CARE values, rights-based and results-oriented approaches, GEDI and PSHEA principles, and adherence to the Code of Conduct, including zero tolerance for abuse and discrimination.
- **External relations, communication, coordination, and policy — 10%:** Oversee the donor portfolio, meet statutory requirements, build donor trust, and directly manage sensitive government relations.
- Represent CARE in senior coordination forums and strengthen staff participation at technical levels. Maintain CARE’s co-chairing and leadership roles in inter-agency coordination inside and outside camps, including its positioning through the Rohingya Coordination Platform.
- Support communications, public relations, and media coverage of programme achievements. Ensure appropriate programme branding and staff capacity to represent CARE.
- **Monitoring, evaluation, learning, and accountability — 10%:** Establish impact, outcome, and output targets with indicators and periodic reviews. Develop and implement a response-wide MEAL framework with the Program Planning, Impact, and Quality (PPIQ) Team.
- Establish cross-sector information management and reporting systems, oversee monitoring plans, and conduct regular field checks of output and outcome quality. Ensure knowledge products meet quality standards and are widely shared.
- Strengthen information dissemination, community complaints and feedback mechanisms, accountability, and quality assurance. Support MEAL work plans with clear responsibilities and align programme quality measures with CARE International requirements.
- **Team building, supervision, and capacity building — 10%:** Coordinate with HR to support staff well-being and adequate rest and relaxation. Provide training, coaching, mentoring, and cross-sector learning, particularly for managers, sector leads, second-line leaders, and potentially partner agencies.
- Build humanitarian leadership, quality, and accountability skills. Train budget holders in budget and grant management, financial responsibilities, and contractual compliance.
- Ensure emergency programme staff work according to humanitarian principles, CARE’s core values, the Code of Conduct, and SPHERE standards.
- **Safety, security, and safeguarding — 5%:** Follow and support CARE Bangladesh’s safety and security policies, protocols, directives, and reporting requirements. Maintain situational awareness and consider the effects of actions on staff, teams, and the organisation.
- Uphold ethical conduct and safeguarding of children, young people, and vulnerable adults. Prevent and report misconduct, including sexual harassment, exploitation, abuse, neglect, fraud, corruption, and financial misconduct, and support regular accountability monitoring.

## Requirements

- A master’s degree in International Development, International Relations, Humanitarian/Disaster Management, Social Science, or a relevant field is required.
- At least 8 years of humanitarian response experience is required, including at least 5 years of progressively responsible experience in programme management, leadership, and design.
- Candidates must demonstrate strong programme development and fundraising experience with international donors, successful resource mobilisation, coordination, and organisational positioning.
- Strong grant management experience and familiarity with institutional, private, and philanthropic funding sources are required.
- Candidates must have experience working with partner organisations in humanitarian or development settings, managing integrated programmes, and supporting capacity building.
- Strong managerial experience is required, including management of multi-million-dollar budgets and delivery of multi-year, multi-site programmes with significant budgets.
- Candidates must demonstrate administrative, financial, and personnel management capabilities, along with experience leading multidisciplinary teams and making complex decisions under difficult circumstances.
- Excellent strategic, analytical, systems-thinking, problem-solving, and judgement skills are required, alongside strong representation and negotiation skills with governments and donors.
- Candidates must understand humanitarian emergency operations, SPHERE standards, the humanitarian system, donors, security, civil-military liaison, programme management, and inter-agency coordination systems.
- Strong project cycle management skills are required across assessment, design, implementation, monitoring, evaluation, and strategic planning.
- Candidates must show commitment to accountability, social justice, gender awareness and equality, and CARE Bangladesh’s mission and long-term work with vulnerable and marginalised communities.
- Flexibility in challenging working conditions, strong learning agility, and willingness to encourage knowledge sharing across projects are required.
- Experience in conflict-affected or post-conflict countries is an asset.

## Work arrangements

- The position is based at CARE Bangladesh’s Cox’s Bazar Regional Office.
- The contract runs up to May 31, 2027.

## Salary and benefits

- The monthly consolidated salary is 3,04,696.00 BDT.

## Hiring process

- CARE is an equal opportunity employer, and internal and external applicants receive equal treatment throughout selection.
- Disabled candidates who meet the essential criteria are guaranteed an interview.
- Personal persuasion or phone calls will result in disqualification.
- CARE participates in the Inter-Agency Misconduct Disclosure Scheme and requests information from previous employers about findings of sexual exploitation, sexual abuse, or sexual harassment, including relevant investigations ongoing when a candidate left employment.
- Employment offers depend on satisfactory references and appropriate screening checks. Submitting an application confirms understanding of these recruitment procedures.

## How to apply

- Apply through [Bdjobs](https://bdjobs.com/) on or before October 20, 2026.
- Internal candidates should discuss their application with their Line Manager and obtain their endorsement.
- There is no application fee. Any request for payment to apply should be treated as fraudulent.

jobs.title: General Protection Officer - Case Management
jobs.description:
The Danish Refugee Council (DRC) is recruiting a General Protection Officer – Case Management in Cox’s Bazar. The officer will manage individual protection cases within DRC’s Bangladesh protection programme, reporting day to day to the Protection Team Leader and receiving technical guidance from the Protection Manager and Coordinator.

## Responsibilities

- Assess individual protection risks, provide Individual Protection Assistance (IPA), and arrange timely referrals through established pathways.
- Identify urgent cases under DRC’s Case Management and IPA Standard Operating Procedures, accompanying people to service points when needed.
- Train, guide, and support field-level protection volunteers to identify and assist people of concern.
- Develop work plans and priorities with the Protection Team Leader, participate in case management meetings, and meet agreed targets on time while maintaining service quality and ethical standards.
- Keep accurate, current, confidential case records and protection data, with secure storage of paper and electronic files.
- Contribute to internal and donor reports with protection trends, challenges, good practices, and valid supporting evidence. Ensure activities meet donor requirements and DRC’s reporting, accountability, and data protection policies.
- Maintain relationships with administrative authorities, humanitarian partners, and community structures. Coordinate responses to protection concerns and use findings to inform case planning and wider programmes.
- Work across DRC teams, including Protection Monitoring, Community-Based Protection, and Gender-Based Violence, to provide integrated services and embed protection principles across activities.
- Represent DRC at assigned field coordination forums, protection sector meetings, inter-agency forums, and community platforms in coordination with the Protection Team Leader.
- Follow DRC procedures for security, finance, logistics, human resources, and administration, and uphold its Code of Conduct, protection principles, and core humanitarian standards.
- Follow global and local safety rules and report incidents, near misses, and relevant safety information as instructed during onboarding. Breaches may result in disciplinary action.
- Carry out other supervisor-assigned duties supporting the protection programme.

## Requirements

- A university degree in social sciences, such as Social Work, Anthropology, Psychology, Development Studies, Law, or a relevant discipline is required. A relevant master’s degree is preferred.
- A minimum of 2–3 years of relevant humanitarian organisation experience, including at least 2 years in the protection sector of the Rohingya refugee response.
- Previous experience with an international or local NGO or a United Nations agency.
- Strong knowledge of protection case management, community-based protection, and protection monitoring.
- Essential proficiency in Chittagonian and Rohingya dialects for community engagement, including sufficient Chittagonian proficiency to communicate with Rohingya speakers.
- Fluency in written and spoken English and Bengali.
- Basic narrative reporting skills, including contributions to case summaries, internal updates, and donor reports.
- Willingness and ability to work in field settings with difficult weather and logistical conditions.
- Strong organisation and time management skills, with the ability to work independently and within a multidisciplinary team.
- Proficiency in Outlook, Word, Excel, and PowerPoint, plus experience with Kobo Toolbox, ActivityInfo, or other data collection and reporting platforms.
- Demonstrate DRC’s five core competencies: pursue results efficiently, collaborate and welcome feedback, take ownership and initiative, communicate honestly and effectively, and act with integrity in line with DRC’s values.

## Work arrangements

- This is a national contract at Employment Band H.
- The duty station is Cox’s Bazar.
- The expected start date is as soon as possible.

## Salary and benefits

- Two bonuses, paid on a pro-rata basis with the monthly salary.
- Mobile and relocation allowances.
- Leave encashment and gratuity.
- Group life insurance including family coverage.
- Dental and optical benefits.
- A supportive working environment, growth opportunities, and access to learning and development platforms.

## How to apply

- Apply through [DRC’s recruitment portal](https://candidate.hr-manager.net/ApplicationInit.aspx?cid=1036&ProjectId=176939&DepartmentId=19152&MediaId=5) by **17 October 2026**. Email applications will not be considered.
- Submit a cover letter and an updated CV in English. DRC encourages CVs of no more than four pages.
- Include details of three referees in your CV: your current supervisor, your current HR representative, and a supervisor from previous employment.
- Female candidates are particularly encouraged to apply. DRC provides equal employment opportunities and values an inclusive workplace.
- DRC does not charge or accept recruitment fees. Do not respond to unsolicited employment offers requesting money.

jobs.title: Medical Doctor, Health - SRH
jobs.description:
The International Rescue Committee (IRC) is hiring a Medical Doctor, Health – SRH to support sexual and reproductive health services in Rohingya refugee camps and host communities. The role reports to the Clinical SRH Manager and supports care delivery across assigned IRC facilities.

## Responsibilities

- Plan and deliver SRH activities, including BEmONC, family planning, syndromic management of sexually transmitted infections, menstrual regulation, post-abortion care, normal vaginal delivery, clinical management of sexual assault, and health education.
- Coordinate with reproductive health and gender-based violence teams to reach vulnerable and hard-to-reach people and increase service use at WSSs and other IRC facilities.
- Provide technical leadership, guidance, training and mentorship to field health staff. Support training on BEmONC and other SRH services.
- Provide long-acting reversible contraception (LARC) services directly at WSSs and other health facilities.
- Maintain accurate SRH records, compile and analyse data, and produce timely, high-quality reports, including required donor reports.
- Work with Senior Managers to increase family planning uptake through community awareness and reliable availability of supplies.
- Develop messages encouraging timely use of emergency SRH services.
- Conduct regular field monitoring visits, assess progress and help resolve technical and implementation issues.
- Coordinate with Women Protection & Empowerment teams to address the varied needs of women and girls.
- Document and share lessons learned and good practices.
- Keep budget spending plans current and maintain SRH project expenditure within budget.
- Represent projects in field-level meetings with community leaders, NGOs, UN agencies and community-based organizations. Coordinate with partners and advocate with or advise peer agencies and local government on inclusive, high-quality SRH services.
- Support project management with Senior Managers, including preparing job descriptions, interviewing and hiring staff, setting performance objectives and completing timely appraisals.
- Monitor medical and operational supply chains, stock records, timely ordering, and accountability for storing and using medicines and medical supplies.
- Carry out other supervisor-assigned duties supporting IRC programmes.

## Requirements

- A completed Bachelor of Medicine and Surgery (MBBS) with valid Bangladesh Medical and Dental Council (BMDC) registration is required.
- At least 2 years of clinical SRH experience at hospital level is required; experience in complex humanitarian or emergency settings is preferred.
- A clear interest in and work experience with the Minimum Initial Service Package (MISP) is required.
- At least 1 year of experience managing health facilities and staff, including supervising and mentoring health workers, is required.
- Post-Graduation Training (PGT) in gynecology and obstetrics is an added advantage.
- Candidates must be able to provide sensitive, appropriate medical counselling and consistently maintain confidentiality and respect in the centres.
- Candidates must be innovative, flexible and adaptable, and willing to work in potentially stressful and challenging environments.
- Proven skills in work planning, data collection and analysis, and performance monitoring are required.
- Candidates must understand the cultural and political environment and work effectively with local health representatives.
- Excellent communication skills, spoken English and concise English report writing are required.
- Excellent computer skills are required in MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Epi-Info/SPSS and Outlook.
- English, Bangla and Chittagonian are the preferred languages.
- Staff must follow the IRC Way and its values of Integrity, Service, Equality and Accountability. Compliance is required with policies covering safeguarding, protection from exploitation and abuse, child safeguarding, a harassment-free workplace, conflicts of interest, fiscal integrity, combating trafficking, reporting wrongdoing and protection from retaliation.

## Work arrangements

- The workstation is IRC Bangladesh camps in Ukhiya and Teknaf, with assignments supporting refugee camps and host communities.
- The contract is maternity coverage until **31 March 2027**.
- The role reports to the Clinical SRH Manager and involves regular field monitoring visits.

## How to apply

Apply through the IRC careers site on Workday by **16 October 2026**. Prepare an ATS-friendly CV tailored to the role.

jobs.title: Senior Field Operations Associate - Infrastructure
jobs.description:
IOM Bangladesh is hiring a Senior Field Operations Associate – Infrastructure in Cox’s Bazar to lead construction and site rehabilitation work supporting the Rohingya refugee response.

## Responsibilities

- Lead and coordinate field implementation of Infrastructure Unit projects and report on progress.
- Supervise, train and guide field staff carrying out construction work.
- Check construction quality against technical specifications and recommend corrective action.
- Guide teams on bills of quantities (BoQ), scheduling, tendering, specifications and contract administration.
- Participate in tender evaluations and coordinate with government counterparts, partners and contractors.

## Requirements

- Hold a Bachelor’s degree in Architecture, Civil Engineering or a related field with five years of relevant experience, or a High School diploma with seven years of relevant experience.
- Have experience implementing civil infrastructure and community-based projects.
- Be fluent in English and Bengali, with working knowledge of the Chittagonian dialect.
- Experience with international organisations or NGOs and camp site development is an advantage.
- Proficiency in AutoCAD and QGIS is an advantage.

## Work arrangements

- The position is based in Cox’s Bazar, Bangladesh.
- The contract is Special Short Term Graded, for up to 9 months, at General Service grade G-7.

## How to apply

Apply through the IOM careers portal by **18 October 2026, 06:00**. Tailor your CV to the role and ensure it is ATS-friendly.

jobs.title: Finance Manager Bangladesh
jobs.description:
The Norwegian Refugee Council (NRC) is hiring a Finance Manager for its Bangladesh mission in Dhaka. The role oversees financial planning, budgeting, controls and services to support humanitarian work with refugees and host communities.

## Responsibilities

- Develop, implement and oversee financial policies, procedures, systems and routines.
- Lead financial planning and management, strengthen controls, monitor organisational performance and advise management.
- Manage finance staff, including performance, workforce planning, recruitment, induction, development and duty of care.
- Provide finance support and supervision, develop finance training and train staff with financial responsibilities.
- Ensure compliance with NRC policies and guidance, donor and auditor requirements, statutory regulations and Bangladesh legal requirements.
- Control budgets, monitor cash flow and provide financial reports and analysis.
- Implement NRC’s anti-corruption policy.
- Uphold safeguarding standards by treating everyone with respect and dignity, helping maintain a safe environment, avoiding exploitation, abuse and harassment—including sexual exploitation, abuse and sexual harassment (SEAH)—and reporting concerns. NRC has zero tolerance for inaction.

## Requirements

- A master’s degree is required.
- Candidates must have senior financial management experience in a humanitarian or recovery context.
- Candidates must be proficient in computer software and modern accounting systems and familiar with Bangladesh’s financial operating context.
- Fluency in written and spoken English is required.
- NRC seeks a hands-on, action-oriented professional with strong communication skills, a record of encouraging collaboration, and an innovative, adaptable and analytical approach.
- Candidates must be legally eligible to work in Bangladesh. NRC cannot provide work permits or visa sponsorship.
- NRC encourages candidates who meet most requirements to apply, although applications below minimum experience or qualification standards will generally not be considered. Female candidates are strongly encouraged to apply.

## Work arrangements

- This is a full-time role based in Dhaka, Bangladesh.
- The contract lasts 12 months.
- Approximately 20% travel is expected.

## Salary and benefits

- Compensation follows Grade 9 of NRC’s National Salary Scale, with its accompanying terms and conditions.
- NRC offers a competitive compensation and benefits package.
- Employees can contribute ideas, take initiative and access professional growth opportunities within a supportive workplace.
- NRC is an equal opportunities employer committed to diversity across age, gender, ethnicity, nationality and physical ability.

## Hiring process

- Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted. NRC cannot provide detailed feedback to applicants who are not shortlisted.
- Unsolicited applications unrelated to this vacancy will not be considered.
- NRC does not charge recruitment fees.

## How to apply

- Apply through the NRC careers portal for **Finance Manager Bangladesh**, job identification **21669**, by **25 October 2026 at 11:55 PM**. The vacancy was posted on **30 September 2026 at 12:34 AM**.
- Use your full name as shown in your passport and complete all required fields covering experience, employment history and education.
- Attach your latest CV and submit both the application and CV in English. Tailor your CV to the role and ensure it is ATS-friendly.
- Internal candidates should log in with their official NRC email address or use Opportunity Marketplace.
- For genuine queries, email **eurasia.recruitment@nrc.no** with the subject line **“Finance Manager Bangladesh”**. This address accepts queries only; applications cannot be submitted by email.

jobs.title: Procurement Officer (Risk and Compliance)
jobs.description:
WFP is recruiting one Procurement Officer (Risk and Compliance) to strengthen procurement governance, risk management and emergency readiness across its Bangladesh operations. Reporting to the Head of Supply Chain, the officer will support the Country Office, Cox’s Bazar Area Office and six Field Offices, working with internal teams, government counterparts and humanitarian partners.

## Responsibilities

- Review procurement practices, monitor compliance with WFP policies and delegated authorities, and implement corrective actions. Address control weaknesses involving waivers, post-factum approvals, operational advances and MPOs.
- Maintain procurement risk registers, track key risk indicators, support mitigation measures, and prepare reports with findings and recommendations.
- Strengthen barter procurement governance to ensure accountability, compliance and value for money. Review evaluation and oversight committees and recommend improvements.
- Support AFAC compliance and fraud prevention through risk assessments, data analysis, awareness activities and fact-finding reviews.
- Coordinate with Procurement, Food Safety & Quality and Programme teams on oversight of HEB, bread and bun production contracts. Review inspection companies’ management, quality controls and verification of production processes.
- Oversee engineering procurement and supply chain compliance.
- Train Requesting Units, MPO approvers, reviewing committee members and field personnel on procurement and compliance.
- Establish and maintain pre-arranged agreements, framework contracts, dedicated vendor rosters, standby agreements, LTAs and contingency procurement mechanisms for emergency response.
- Expedite compliant procurement of goods, services and works, ensuring essential relief supplies and services are available during cyclones, floods, landslides and other emergencies, with particular emphasis on earthquakes.
- Develop procurement dashboards, compliance monitoring tools and management reports. Analyse performance, compliance trends, audit observations and AFAC issues to inform decisions.
- Support national procurement staff and coordination between Country and Field Offices through support missions, monitoring, technical assessments and knowledge sharing.
- Support the CWG with tendering and contracting Financial Service Providers to expand Cash-Based Transfer capacities, manage risks and maintain operational readiness.
- Improve vendor management, internal controls, quality assurance and procurement capacity, including reducing waivers and post-factum approvals. Specific deliverables and outputs will be assigned and adjusted to operational priorities.

## Requirements

- The education criteria state that an advanced university degree (Master’s or equivalent) is required. They also list a first university degree (Bachelor’s or equivalent) with additional relevant work experience as an alternative. Relevant fields include Supply Chain Management, Procurement or another related discipline.
- Candidates must have at least 5 years of progressive procurement experience, with a strong emphasis on risk mitigation, supplier auditing and compliance within UN agencies.
- Procurement field experience in emergencies and disaster preparedness and response is essential. Experience in UN emergency operations is an added advantage.
- Fluency in written and spoken English is required.
- Employees must demonstrate the standards of behaviour in the WFP Leadership Framework.
- Members of UN bodies with oversight responsibilities over WFP are ineligible for appointment during their service and for three years after leaving. This includes ACABQ, ICSC, the FAO Finance Committee, WFP External Auditor, WFP Audit Committee, JIU and similar bodies.

## Work arrangements

- The duty station is Dhaka.
- This is an International Consultancy at grade CST ll, lasting 6 Months.
- There is 01 position available.

## Salary and benefits

- WFP advertises an attractive compensation package but provides no salary amount in the supplied text.
- WFP offers an inclusive, multicultural work environment and development opportunities through training, accreditation, coaching, mentorship and internal mobility.

## Hiring process

- Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted to proceed to the next stage.
- All documents will be verified. Any discrepancies will result in automatic disqualification.
- Additional documents, such as passports, certificates and recommendation letters, may be requested later.
- Selected candidates will undergo rigorous reference and background checks.
- Recruitment decisions are based on organizational needs, job requirements, merit and individual qualifications. WFP welcomes qualified applicants from all backgrounds.
- Reasonable accommodations are available throughout recruitment. Requests can be sent to global.inclusion@wfp.org.
- The United Nations charges no application, processing, training, interviewing, testing or other recruitment fees. Disregard requests for payment and exercise care when sharing personal or banking information online.

## How to apply

- Submit your application exclusively through WFP’s online recruitment portal by **19 October 2026 at 23:59, GMT+06:00 Bangladesh Standard Time (Dhaka)**.
- Complete your Workday profile accurately, including employment history, academic qualifications, language skills and UN grade, if applicable.
- Submit your CV and Cover Letter; these are the only documents required at the application stage. The application instructions advise tailoring your CV to the role and making it ATS-friendly.
- Applications sent by email, LinkedIn or any other channel will not be considered.
- For technical problems with your application, contact global.hrerecruitment@wfp.org. This inbox does not accept applications or unsolicited documents.
- If you had an account on WFP’s previous recruitment platform, create a new account for future applications. Ongoing recruitment processes are unaffected.

jobs.title: Safe Shelter Manager
jobs.description:
World Vision Bangladesh is hiring a Safe Shelter Manager to oversee a secure, dignified shelter for women and girls affected by gender-based violence (GBV). The role manages daily operations, staff, protection services and referrals to support survivors’ safety, recovery and reintegration. Only female, local applicants are eligible.

## Responsibilities

- Manage daily shelter operations and maintain a safe, clean, supportive and survivor-centered living environment.
- Conduct resident intake, orientation and risk assessments, develop individualized support plans, and implement safety measures and risk mitigation plans.
- Ensure timely access to accommodation, food, clothing, hygiene supplies, medical support and other essential services.
- Coordinate case management, psychosocial support, healthcare, legal assistance and specialized referrals. Support survivors to make informed decisions and transition safely to longer-term support and reintegration options.
- Supervise shelter staff, support personnel and service providers. Monitor performance, provide coaching, identify development needs, and deliver training on survivor-centered care, safeguarding, PSEA, confidentiality, security and emergency response.
- Manage facilities, resources, supplies and inventories. Monitor shelter capacity, address operational challenges and recommend service improvements.
- Maintain accurate, confidential resident records and shelter documentation, and prepare progress reports, case updates and management reports.
- Plan activities that strengthen residents’ well-being, life skills, psychosocial recovery and social reintegration.
- Maintain partnerships and safe, confidential referral pathways with GBV providers, health facilities, legal aid organizations, psychosocial services, government agencies and local authorities.
- Work with case managers, protection teams, community leaders, women-led organizations and community protection structures. Represent the shelter in relevant coordination and GBV working groups.
- Advocate for survivors’ rights, safety, dignity and access to protection, health, legal, livelihood and psychosocial services. Identify service gaps, address barriers and support GBV awareness activities.
- Uphold safeguarding, PSEA, organizational policies and survivor-centered, gender-sensitive, disability-inclusive and confidentiality principles.
- Demonstrate World Vision’s Core Values, participate in working groups and exposure visits, share learning, and pursue personal and professional development aligned with World Vision Response strategic goals.

## Requirements

- A bachelor’s degree, preferably in social science, social work or psychology. The advert also lists a postgraduate degree without specifying a subject or whether it is preferred.
- At least 3 years of experience in a GBV-related field.
- An understanding of the project’s issues and current development and emerging issues.
- Skills in writing project concept papers and design documents, forecasting, budgeting, baseline surveys, evaluation and monitoring methods and tools.
- The ability to facilitate training, seminars and advocacy activities, with proven management and leadership skills.
- Strong communication, networking, decision-making and conflict-resolution skills.
- Good written and spoken English and Bengali. The required languages are listed as English, Bangla and Rohingya; the advert also states that Chittagong/Rohingya language skills will be taken into consideration.
- Proficiency in MS Word, MS Excel and PowerPoint.
- The ability to manage multiple tasks, work under stressful conditions and adapt to local culture and circumstances.
- Flexibility to work rotating day and night shifts, weekends and holidays, accept assignment to any project-supported location, and travel to various BRCR locations as required.
- Commitment to World Vision’s values and safeguarding standards. Persons with disabilities are encouraged to apply.

## Work arrangements

- This is a full-time position lasting until February 2027.
- The shelter operates 24/7. The manager must support operations beyond regular office hours, including night shifts, weekends and emergencies, as needed.
- The manager must remain reachable by mobile phone at all times for urgent shelter matters, staff support and emergency coordination.

## Salary and benefits

- Salary is negotiable.
- World Vision describes a competitive Total Rewards package tailored to the local work context; specific benefits are not listed.

## Hiring process

- Recruits undergo checks and compliance procedures under World Vision’s Child and Adult Safeguarding Policy.
- World Vision has zero tolerance for violence, abuse, sexual exploitation or abuse involving children or adults. It discourages applications from anyone with a prior conviction related to child neglect, abuse or exploitation.

## How to apply

- Apply through the World Vision careers site on Workday by **18 October 2026**.
- Submit an ATS-friendly CV tailored to this role.

jobs.title: HR Manager
jobs.description:
First4Freelancers is urgently hiring an experienced HR Manager in Dhaka to lead HR operations, recruitment, employee administration and employee relations.

## Responsibilities

- Oversee daily HR operations and implement company policies, procedures and HR practices.
- Manage sick, emergency and other leave requests. Maintain accurate employee files, HR databases, attendance and leave records, and monitor attendance, punctuality and working hours for policy compliance.
- Lead recruitment from manpower planning, job postings and candidate sourcing through CV screening, interviews, selection and offer management.
- Coordinate onboarding and induction, including documentation, orientation and employee integration.
- Manage training, probation reviews and performance feedback, and issue probation confirmation or extension letters.
- Coordinate with payroll on salary revisions, increments, promotions, deductions, probation status, designations and employee information.
- Prepare appointment, confirmation and promotion letters; salary and experience certificates; resignation acceptance and warning letters; and termination correspondence.

jobs.title: Distribution Channel Senior Manager, NEO PSP Limited
jobs.description:
NEO PSP Limited, a wholly owned Banglalink subsidiary within the VEON Group, is hiring a Distribution Channel Senior Manager to lead Mukto Pay’s distribution and merchant acceptance network in Bangladesh. The company holds a Payment Service Provider (PSP) licence and is developing payment solutions for businesses. The role reports to the Head of Growth.

## Responsibilities

- Build and manage the distribution network across agents, super agents, distributors, merchant acceptance points, and Banglalink’s retail and dealer network.
- Prioritise agents who transact every month at commercially viable volumes, and merchants who accept payments weekly, rather than measuring success through registrations alone.
- Manage agent liquidity and float, including rebalancing, float financing arrangements, and reliable cash and e-money availability for cash-in and cash-out transactions.
- Use Banglalink’s dealers, retail points and field organisation within the limits permitted by the PSP licence and Bangladesh Bank. Agree and document these arrangements with Compliance before rollout.
- Execute commission structures within the margin band set by the CCO. Monitor monthly agent earnings, commercial viability and earnings per active agent as an early indicator of churn.
- Ensure accurate, timely commission and incentive payments, and resolve payout disputes.
- Build and lead the field organisation, covering territory design, coverage planning, field KPIs, route discipline, and supervision of distributors and their field staff.
- Manage agent and merchant recruitment standards, KYC, due diligence, contracts, and training and certification with Customer Experience. De-list participants who breach standards.
- Develop merchant acceptance in priority categories and ensure sufficient field capacity to acquire and activate merchants.
- Provide channel capacity forecasts for Product Owners and Marketing. Give an evidence-based readiness assessment at the Launch Readiness Review and decline acquisition campaigns the channel cannot support.
- Work with Risk to address agent fraud, collusion, over-the-counter transaction abuse and KYC integrity issues, taking action on identified exceptions.
- Report performance with Business Intelligence using active agents, throughput per active agent, district coverage, liquidity uptime, agent earnings and agent churn.

## Requirements

- A bachelor’s degree in business, marketing, economics or a related field is required. A master’s degree is welcome but optional.
- Candidates must have 8–10 years of experience in distribution, channel or field sales management, including running a distributor or agent network at regional or national scale.
- Relevant experience must include telecom distribution, MFS or mobile money agent networks, FMCG distribution, or consumer finance field networks.
- Direct experience with agent or retailer commission structures and their influence on channel behaviour is required, beyond simply implementing another person’s scheme.
- Experience managing agent liquidity and float is strongly preferred.
- Candidates must have built coverage from a low starting point in a market with an established incumbent.
- Bangladesh market experience and field credibility outside Dhaka are essential.
- Candidates must assess adoption through active agents and transaction throughput, and understand agent economics, including daily earnings and returns from competitors’ float.
- Strong numerical skills are required to assess cost per active agent, customer acquisition cost by channel, and commissions as a share of revenue.
- Candidates must be able to challenge campaign timing when channel capacity is insufficient, manage distributors against targets and consequences, and de-list underperformers.
- Candidates must recognise and act on agent fraud and over-the-counter abuse in a relationship-driven market.
- Fluent written and spoken English and strong Bangla are required.

## Work arrangements

- The role requires time in the field across districts, working directly with agents.

## How to apply

- Apply through the NEO PSP careers portal by **19 October 2026**.

jobs.title: Senior Specialist - Compensation, HR Analytics & Operations
jobs.description:
Singer Bangladesh Limited is hiring a Senior Specialist – Compensation, HR Analytics & Operations to lead Total Rewards, people analytics, HR systems, workforce planning, and HR governance. The role will advise senior management using workforce data, manage employee costs, and improve HR policies and processes.

## Responsibilities

- Lead Total Rewards strategy, including salary structures, grading, incentives, bonuses, and benefits.
- Manage market benchmarking, pay equity, compensation analysis, and annual salary reviews. Recommend competitive and sustainable reward policies.
- Develop people analytics, HR dashboards, workforce analysis, and HR KPI frameworks.
- Analyze headcount, turnover, employee costs, productivity, compensation, and workforce trends.
- Lead personnel cost budgeting, forecasting, scenario modelling, and cost optimization.
- Improve SAP-HCM/HRIS effectiveness through automation, digitalization, and process improvements.
- Maintain HR data accuracy, integrity, security, governance, and reporting standards.
- Oversee payroll inputs, compensation records, deductions, incentives, and employee changes.
- Govern employee benefits and regularly assess their cost, competitiveness, and value to employees.
- Partner with HR and Finance on manpower planning, restructuring, budgets, and workforce costs.
- Provide senior management with data-driven recommendations on rewards, people analytics, HR technology, and workforce decisions.
- Develop, review, and periodically update compensation and benefits, HRIS, payroll, and related HR policies. Keep them practical, compliant, competitive, and aligned with business strategy.
- Establish policy review cycles, controls, governance, and effective implementation.
- Lead cross-functional initiatives and strengthen the team’s capabilities and analytical skills.
- Submit timely, accurate reports required locally, regionally, and globally, covering headcount, turnover, payroll, benefits utilization, salary reviews, overtime, attrition, and workforce analytics.

## Requirements

- Applicants must be 30 to 40 years old.
- Hold one of the listed qualifications: an MBA in Human Resource Management, Accounting, or Management Information System; an MSc in Mathematics or Statistics; or an MSS in Economics.
- Have at least 8 years of experience, including experience in electronic equipment/home appliances or multinational companies.
- Demonstrate extensive experience and advanced proficiency in spreadsheets, data analysis, reporting, and financial modelling.
- Have proven senior HR experience covering compensation strategy, workforce costing, HR policy, and data-driven decision-making.
- Have strong knowledge of SAP-HCM/HRIS, HR analytics, budgeting, labour law, payroll, and benefits.
- Bring strong analytical, financial, communication, and stakeholder management skills.

## Work arrangements

- This is a full-time, office-based role in Gulshan 2, Dhaka.

## Salary and benefits

- Salary is negotiable, with a yearly salary review.
- Benefits include a provident fund, profit sharing, gratuity, insurance, and a performance bonus.
- Employees receive 2 weekly holidays and 2 festival bonuses.
- LFA and medical bill reimbursement are provided.

## How to apply

Apply through the Singer Bangladesh Limited listing on bdjobs.com by **23 October 2026**. Ensure your CV is ATS-friendly and tailored to this role.

jobs.title: Assistant Manager, Sales (Consumer Products Testing & Inspection)
jobs.description:
TÜV Rheinland Bangladesh Pvt. Ltd. is hiring an Assistant Manager, Sales for its Consumer Products Testing & Inspection services. The role focuses on winning new business, developing client relationships, and achieving individual and company sales targets.

## Responsibilities

- Visit existing and prospective clients regularly to generate sales and meet targets.
- Identify and qualify prospects among brands, retailers, buying houses, sourcing offices, traders, and garment and accessories manufacturers.
- Lead discovery meetings, capability presentations, site visits, and discussions to match services to client needs.
- Promote the company’s brand and services across industrial territories, including Savar, Gazipur, and Narayanganj.
- Respond to customer queries, prepare quotations, coordinate proposals and tenders, and negotiate commercial terms through deal closure.
- Work with operations and technical teams to develop compliant, profitable proposals.
- Run sales campaigns and cross-selling initiatives to expand services for existing clients.
- Coordinate customer onboarding, credit setup, and operational handover after securing business.
- Monitor initial client transactions to ensure full revenue realization and customer satisfaction before handing over long-term account management.
- Track market trends, Testing, Inspection and Certification (TIC) industry developments, competitor activity, and client needs.
- Keep CRM or sales-tracking records current, including leads, client visits, opportunities, pipeline forecasts, and win/loss analysis.
- Organize workshops, seminars, webinars, and client training on compliance and testing solutions.
- Support brand promotion through local industry publications and newsletters.

## Requirements

- Hold a master’s degree in Marketing, Business Administration, or Management, or an MBA with a major in any discipline. Candidates with a bachelor’s degree in Textile Engineering/Technology and an MBA majoring in Marketing will also be considered.
- Have 7–8 years of relevant sales or business development experience in Consumer Products Testing & Inspection, garment accessories, or related garment/textile service industries.
- The employer also states that a minimum of 7–8 years of direct, proven sales experience in the TIC, garment, retail, or sourcing industry is mandatory.
- Demonstrate a proven record of direct sales generation and key account management.
- Show strong business judgment, a customer-focused approach, and the ability to handle buyers.
- Be self-motivated and proactive in finding and closing new business opportunities.
- Have excellent written and spoken English.
- Have strong interpersonal skills for working with senior client management, factory management, and internal teams.

## Work arrangements

- Extensive local travel is required across Dhaka, Savar, Narayanganj, Gazipur, and other manufacturing zones throughout Bangladesh.
- The role offers a 2-day weekend.

## Salary and benefits

- Benefits include group life insurance and health insurance covering the employee, spouse, and 2 children.
- Gratuity, sales incentives, a provident fund, two festival bonuses, and an annual salary review are provided.
- Other facilities follow company policy.

## How to apply

- Apply through the TÜV Rheinland job circular on bdjobs.com by October 17, 2026.
- Ensure your CV is ATS-friendly and tailored to this role.

jobs.title: Channel / Market Operations Executive

jobs.title: Associate Oncall Engineer

jobs.title: DevOps Administrator
jobs.description:
Therap (BD) Ltd. is hiring a DevOps Administrator with 1–3 years of experience for a hands-on role supporting and improving production environments. The work focuses on Linux administration, Java application troubleshooting, and practical SRE approaches to reliability and performance.

## Responsibilities

- Manage Linux systems, including daily administration, troubleshooting, performance tuning, and basic security hardening.
- Support Java-based applications and their web and application servers.
- Maintain and improve CI/CD build and deployment pipelines, automating repetitive tasks where possible.
- Investigate deployment failures, performance problems, and unexpected system behavior using logs and metrics to identify root causes.
- Write and maintain scripts, primarily in Bash, with Python where appropriate.
- Participate in production releases and handle off-hours issues when required, with support duties shared across the team.

## Requirements

- A B.Sc. in CSE, EEE, or a related technical field is required.
- Candidates must have 1–3 years of experience in DevOps, system administration, or a similar role.
- Strong Linux fundamentals and confidence using the command line are required.
- Candidates need practical troubleshooting and analytical skills.
- A basic understanding of JVM-based applications is required, including memory usage, logs, and common failure patterns.
- Candidates should be willing to learn, take ownership, and persist through technical problems.

Preferred qualifications:

- Exposure to Docker, Kubernetes, or similar container technologies is desirable; home lab experience counts.
- Experience with monitoring or observability tools such as Prometheus or Grafana is preferred.
- Experience supporting production systems and familiarity with modern DevOps practices are desirable.

## Work arrangements

- Off-hours production support may be required, with responsibilities shared across the team.

## Salary and benefits

- The role offers experience with live production systems, a supportive team, and opportunities to develop further in DevOps engineering.
